subject: project:gdl
value:
TWO CENSUSES OF SCORE-INVISIBLE DEFECTS, taken with the columns run-41's TOOL lane shipped, over every unit pair in the tree at commit 7300fe688. Neither class is visible to `real`, the opcode multiset, objdiff fuzzy or wf_word_diff's word count, and NONE of the functions below was fixed by this lane: every one lives in a TU the TOOL lane does not own. Reproduce any row in zero builds.

CENSUS A, POOL ROWS `fndiff --clean` NORMALIZES AWAY (257 unit pairs). 3,222 rows in 628 functions are kind-differing-but-value-equal and stay silent, correctly. 45 rows in 22 functions are WRONG-POOL-DATUM (both symbols resolve to concrete and DIFFERENT addresses) and 177 rows in 58 functions are WRONG-POOL-VALUE (a named target datum against our anonymous pool entry whose BYTES disagree). 72 functions carry at least one, and 23 of those read `real 0` in --clean today — a false all-clear. Command: `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py <unit> <fn> --clean`.

FOUR SPOT CHECKS, all four genuine, each value read from the retail image with tools/gdl/poolval.py and each pairing confirmed in the aligned `fnasm --diff` view rather than at a same-absolute-offset comparison:
  game/game/player::PlayerRestoreState (real 0) — target `lfd f4,@lbl_803477D0` = 100.0 and `lfd f1,@lbl_80347830` = 500.0 against our @1120 = 0.5 and @1691 = 30.0. The source reads `cap = 0.5 * (p->level - 1) + 30.0;` where the retail computes `100.0 * (level - 1) + 500.0`. A GAMEPLAY defect: the hidden character's health cap. The identical expression appears in PlayersRestoreHealth immediately above it, which is also flagged.
  game/game/player::start_magic (real 0) — target lbl_80347868 = 1.5, ours @651 = -1.5. A sign.
  game/enemy/enemy::move_logic00 (real 0) — target reads 2*pi then pi at +0x1dc/+0x1e4; ours reads pi then 2*pi. The two constants are SWAPPED.
  game/anim/atree::AtreeNodeInit (real 0) — target string 'AtreeNodeInit: Malloc't return 0 (too many nodes).' against our 'AtreeNodeInit: Malloc't returned NULL.' First differing byte +0x21.

CENSUS B, RELOCATION SYMBOLS AT IDENTICAL INSTRUCTION WORDS (2,826 count-symmetric functions comparable, 47 not comparable and reported as UNSCREENED rather than clean). 15 functions carry a relocation whose word is identical in both streams and whose symbol resolves to a different address; 7 of those have at least one INDEX-ALIGNED row, which is the trustworthy subset — in a stream with mnemonic divergence nearby an unlinked `bl` is the same word whatever it calls, so an offset-paired row there may not be the same instruction. Command: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn>`.
  INDEX-ALIGNED (firm): enemy::damage_enemy +0x418; player::set_hidden_player 4 rows +0x38..+0x84 (a four-way rotation of lbl_803479C8/D0/D8/E0); pb_diag::pbDiagDrawAudio +0x4/+0xc and pb_diag::pbDiagDrawInfo 4 rows (argument-register SWAPS: target `lis r5,@buttons` / `lis r4,@lbl_80114E90`, ours the reverse); sounds::InitNameAudio +0xc/+0x1c; camera::camera_mode_dest 4 rows; items::update_player_milestone +0x194.
  NOT INDEX-ALIGNED (read the aligned view first): movieplayer::PlayVQMovie (__destroy_new_array vs ResetAllocTot), camera::camera_mode_follow +0x8c8 (get_cam_wpos vs calc_cam_pyr), memcard::check_prefs_loaded 5 rows, options::show_optmenu 2 rows, psfx::PlyrSfxDoDamage, sounds::ShopMusicStart, gauntworld::fn_8005FB48, items::RegisterItemWobj.

WHY THIS IS A QUEUE AND NOT A CURIOSITY. Both censuses extend a class this project has now hit in four separate runs (claim.law.SL_pool-constant-errors-are-score-invisible; claim.law.SA_a-wrong-global-that-shares-an-instruction-word-is-invisible-to-every-score-including-the-word-count.20260902.v1; the 13 constant bugs of run 34 and the 5 of run 31, all in player.c). Four of four spot checks were real, two of them gameplay defects. Every row above is a candidate a source lane can fix in one identifier or one literal, byte-neutral, and none of them will ever be surfaced by ranking a queue on fuzzy or real.
